assets_investigated.result: Static brochure site. No API refs in HTML/JS. Manifest is PWA config only.
Angular SPA. JS bundle contains AsyncAPI schemas and internal Confluence/DMS links. Backend api-backend.api.sbb.ch returns 401 consistently.
Staging/int environment. Returns identical Angular SPA shell for ALL paths including /actuator, /health, /debug. Confirmed catch-all fallback. No debug endpoints exposed.
Redirects to Microsoft Azure AD SSO login. Not publicly accessible.
OpenText Livelink DMS. Redirects to Microsoft Azure AD SSO login. Not publicly accessible.
Most subdomains NXDOMAIN or timeout. shop.sbb.ch (403 AWS ELB), login.sbb.ch (403). No takeover candidates found.

verdict: All discovered internal assets are behind SSO/Cloudflare or return generic SPA shells. No exploitable misconfigurations, info disclosures, or takeover vectors identified. Pivot recommended.
